spec_match.rationale: Probes natively for anchor positioning and @container anchored support to toggle badges.

interactive.rationale: Excellent draggable anchor node allows continuous sandbox movements, triggering live updates and geometric quadrant readouts.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Fabulous and instructive position playground showing active CSS variables and structures.

edge_cases.rationale: Provides a JavaScript-based fallback positioning helper so the playground is fully functional even on older browsers.

design_system.rationale: Uses theme variables beautifully with very high contrast.
